defects.stage: post-init proof audit after first complete control pass
defects.symptom: Original P1 said the frozen all-distinct cross-ratio/PGL theorems identify every arbitrary-factor profile-(4,4) circuit as a bilinear/Moebius support.
defects.cause: Those frozen theorems assume two 2-row GRS factors. The n-factor theorem assumes only nonzero columns and sparks at least 3.
defects.impact: No numeric pin, instrument path, candidate at-most-two-coordinate theorem, or count formula depended on the overbroad sentence. The general proof needs only that profile (4,4) is the abstract all-distinct two-factor channel counted by N_nf; the Moebius normal form is used only for the GRS census anchors.
defects.resolution: Amended the prereg to retain arbitrary profile-(4,4) circuits abstractly in N_nf and restrict the Moebius classification to the 2-row GRS controls. Preserved original prereg and first-pass results; provenance records both commits and hashes. Reran the complete unchanged T1-T5 family after amendment.
